headline_marked: Trump envoys [[meet Putin in Moscow]] to discuss ending Ukraine war
headline: Trump envoys meet Putin in Moscow to discuss ending Ukraine war
summary: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met with the Russian President to discuss a peace proposal, while both nations agreed to a temporary halt in attacks on each other's capitals.
details: Russian President Vladimir Putin met with US President Donald Trump's envoys, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, at the Kremlin on Saturday. The discussions focused on finding ways to end the conflict in Ukraine, which has lasted nearly five years.

Both Russia and Ukraine have committed to a three-day ceasefire in their respective capitals. The Kremlin announced that Russia would not attack Kyiv from midnight Saturday, while President Volodymyr Zelenskyy agreed to halt attacks on Moscow until Monday.

President Trump had previously indicated that he has a specific new proposal to end the war, though the details of the plan have not been disclosed. Kushner and Witkoff are scheduled to visit Kyiv on Sunday to continue the peace talks.

The diplomatic push comes amid a surge in civilian casualties this summer. Despite the talks, Ukraine reported at least seven deaths on Saturday, including residents in the outskirts of Kyiv and the Dnipro region.
President Zelenskyy accused Russia of attempting to sabotage the diplomatic efforts by launching overnight attacks on Kyiv's airports and civilian infrastructure just before the envoys' visit.

The diplomatic push comes amid a surge in civilian casualties this summer. Despite the talks, Ukraine reported at least seven deaths on Saturday, including residents in the outskirts of Kyiv and the Dnipro region.

headline_marked: Businessman [[shot inside his shop]] in Dhaka, 1 detained
headline: Businessman shot inside his shop in Dhaka, 1 detained
summary: Aslam Khan, 38, was shot in the cheek and hand while talking to a customer at his crockery store in Shonir Akhra.
details: A businessman named Aslam Khan, 38, was shot and injured inside his business establishment in the Shonir Akhra area of the capital on Saturday night.

The incident occurred around 8 PM on Shonir Akhra Zia Smriti Road in Kadamtali, Jatrabari. The victim was immediately rushed to a local hospital and later transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital.
According to the victim's cousin, Miraj Khan, Aslam was talking to a customer inside his crockery shop when a man entered and shot him.
The gunfire hit Aslam Khan in his left hand and right cheek. His family members stated they were unaware of the motive behind the attack.
Local residents caught the attacker as he attempted to flee the scene. The suspect was subsequently handed over to the police for further investigation.
